title: PlayerCore: Integrations
summary: Understand how PlayerCore travel can respect wider world, map, and runtime systems.

blocks.title: World Context
blocks.body: When a pack connects travel to world rules, random teleport and safe-destination checks can become part of route planning instead of a shortcut around danger.

blocks.title: Map And Diagnostics
blocks.body: HoloMap and runtime diagnostics can help admins and players understand why a route is safe, blocked, expensive, or worth bookmarking.

blocks.title: Standalone Fallback
blocks.body: PlayerCore stays useful without optional addons. Commands, config, saved locations, and safety checks are the core experience.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
